Based on my search, I can provide you with information about **Volume V of "The Book of the Thousand Nights and One Night"** by Sir Richard F. Burton.

## Overview

This is the fifth volume of Burton's famous 16-volume translation of the *Arabian Nights*, first published between 1885–1888. The Dunyazad Digital Library has made this volume available as a free PDF e-book.

## Notable Features

The volume is dedicated "To Doctor George Bird" and includes Burton's personal dedication dated October 20, 1885, from the Athenaeum Club. The tales range from romantic adventures like "The Ebony Horse" and "Rose-in-Hood" to religious and moral tales, as well as humorous stories like "How Abu Hasan Brake Wind." The volume also contains several stories featuring the famous Caliph Harun al-Rashid and his court.

The PDF is available for free download from the Dunyazad Digital Library, which notes that according to Austrian law, the text is in the public domain.
